jobs.title: Payroll Specialist - UKG Implementation Support
jobs.description:
**Payroll Specialist**

**UKG Implementation Support**

**LaserAway | Remote | Part-Time | Temporary | $40 per hour**

**Job Summary**

LaserAway is seeking an experienced Payroll Specialist to provide hands-on support during our transition from ADP to UKG. Working under the direction of the Payroll lead and implementation team, this role will assist with data preparation, payroll testing, reconciliation, documentation, and initial payroll processing.

The project includes a transition from semi-monthly to biweekly payroll and a new Saturday–Friday workweek. This position will complete assigned tasks using approved requirements, templates, and testing plans. Payroll leadership and the implementation partner will retain responsibility for configuration decisions, test strategy, payroll controls, and final go-live approval.

**Essential Responsibilities**

**Payroll Data and Testing**

* Prepare and review employee and payroll data using established templates and mapping instructions; identify missing or inconsistent information.
* Compare ADP and UKG payroll reports to validate earnings, deductions, taxes, commissions, and employee balances; document and escalate discrepancies.
* Execute assigned payroll test scripts and parallel payroll comparisons; maintain clear records of results and unresolved items.
* Review timekeeping inputs and payroll calculations against approved requirements, including payroll calendar and workweek changes.

**Documentation and Project Support**

* Maintain testing logs, issue trackers, and supporting records using established project procedures.
* Document approved payroll procedures and workflows; update job aids based on Payroll team guidance.
* Participate in scheduled project meetings and provide timely updates on assigned tasks, outstanding questions, and deadline risks.

**Go Live and Payroll Support**

* Assist with payroll data review and reconciliation during cutover and initial UKG payroll cycles.
* Research routine payroll discrepancies and route system configuration or integration issues to the Payroll lead or implementation partner.
* Support the Payroll team with documentation and knowledge sharing as approved processes move into regular use.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 3+ years of hands-on payroll experience, including payroll data review and reconciliation.
* Working knowledge of earnings, deductions, payroll taxes, overtime, commissions, benefits deductions, and timekeeping inputs.
* Experience using a payroll or HRIS platform and comparing payroll reports to identify and investigate discrepancies.
* Intermediate Excel proficiency, including sorting, filtering, formulas, lookups, and pivot tables for payroll reconciliation.
* Strong attention to detail, organization, and follow-through; ability to handle confidential employee information appropriately.
* Ability to complete defined tasks independently, follow established procedures, communicate findings clearly, and escalate questions promptly.
* Availability for agreed part-time work hours and scheduled meetings within the Eastern Time business day.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience with UKG Payroll; UKG timekeeping experience is also helpful.
* Experience with ADP Workforce Now.
* Participation in a payroll system implementation, conversion, testing, or parallel payroll project.
* Experience supporting multi-state or multi-location payroll.
* Experience documenting payroll procedures or supporting changes to payroll calendars or pay frequency.

**Assignment and Schedule**

**Duration:** Anticipated 6–11 months.

**Compensation:** $40-$43 per hour.

**Schedule:** Part-time, with weekly hours and recurring work blocks agreed before the assignment begins. Scheduled meetings and collaboration will occur within Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–4:30 p.m. Eastern Time. Any additional hours needed for testing, cutover, or payroll deadlines will be discussed and agreed in advance.

**Employment type:** Temporary assignment. Any opportunity for ongoing employment will be discussed separately.

Join a mission-driven team focused on proactive customer success and long-term partnership. You'll collaborate with supportive colleagues, impact business growth, and play a critical role in ensuring our customers thrive with GoCanvas & SiteDocs solutions.

jobs.title: Software Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**Tallyforth Software**  
*From booked job to paid invoice.*

Tallyforth develops scheduling, dispatch, quoting, and invoicing software for commercial cleaning, landscaping, electrical, and property-maintenance companies. Customers use the platform to manage field employees, recurring work, customer records, and payments. The company is headquartered in Kansas City and employs a distributed team across the United States.

**Software Implementation Specialist**

**Location:** Remote within the United States  
**Work arrangement:** Fully remote, with optional access to the Kansas City office  
**Employment:** Full-time, salaried and exempt  
**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, with core availability from 10:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m. Central Time  
**Hours:** Approximately 40 hours per week  
**Base salary:** $72,000–$88,000 per year, depending on relevant implementation experience and demonstrated technical skills  
**Annual bonus:** Target bonus of 8% based on individual objectives and company performance  
**Travel:** Up to 10% for selected customer launches and company meetings  
**Sales quota:** None  
**Reports to:** Implementation Team Lead  
**Direct reports:** None

The role

Tallyforth is hiring a Software Implementation Specialist to help new customers configure the platform, prepare their data, train employees, and complete a successful launch.

You will typically manage 8–10 active customer implementations with timelines of approximately 6–10 weeks. The position does not require software development, advanced programming, or responsibility for selling additional products.

What you will do

* Lead implementation kickoff meetings and confirm the customer’s goals, timeline, participants, and launch requirements.
* Learn how the customer currently schedules work, dispatches employees, prepares quotes, and issues invoices.
* Configure user permissions, service categories, workflows, forms, notifications, and account settings.
* Guide customers through standardized employee, customer, service, and pricing data imports.
* Review spreadsheet and CSV files for formatting issues before data is uploaded.
* Deliver remote administrator and end-user training sessions.
* Maintain an implementation plan with clear tasks, owners, deadlines, risks, and decisions.
* Test configured workflows and help customers complete launch-readiness checks.
* Escalate technical defects, unusual data requirements, and integration questions to the appropriate internal team.
* Document the final configuration and transfer the account to customer support and account management after launch.

What you need

* At least two years of experience in software implementation, customer onboarding, customer success, technical support, business systems, or another client-facing software role.
* Experience leading customer meetings and explaining software to users with different levels of technical experience.
* Strong spreadsheet skills, including sorting, filtering, basic formulas, data cleanup, and CSV formatting.
* Ability to manage several customer projects without losing track of decisions or deadlines.
* Clear written communication and organized documentation.
* Confidence learning configurable software and troubleshooting routine workflow problems.
* Availability during the stated Central Time core hours.

A bachelor’s degree is not required. Equivalent experience gained through customer operations, project work, software support, military service, or technical training may qualify.

Experience with CRM, scheduling, accounting, payroll, field-service, or workforce-management software is helpful. SQL, API development, and programming experience are not required.

Workload and customer schedule

Implementation specialists normally attend two to four customer meetings per day. The remaining time is reserved for configuration, data review, testing, documentation, and internal collaboration.

Customer meetings are scheduled during standard U.S. business hours. Occasional early or late meetings may be required for customers in different time zones, but employees may adjust their schedule on those days.

Weekend work is not normally required. A planned weekend launch may occur fewer than four times per year and requires the employee’s agreement and at least two weeks’ notice.

What success looks like

During the first 60 days, you will complete product training, observe implementations, practice configuration in a test environment, and begin supporting lower-complexity customers.

By six months, you should be able to independently manage a standard implementation from kickoff through launch and customer handoff.

Performance is evaluated through configuration accuracy, customer readiness, project documentation, appropriate escalation, customer feedback, and successful handoffs. Employees are not rewarded for launching an account before the customer is adequately prepared.

Compensation and benefits

Starting salary is determined by relevant SaaS experience, implementation ownership, customer-training ability, spreadsheet proficiency, software-configuration skills, and experience managing concurrent projects.

The annual target bonus is 8% of base salary. Actual payment may range from 0% to 12% based on company performance and documented individual objectives. The bonus is not tied to product sales or customer upselling.

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance with company premium contributions, an HSA option with an employer contribution, and access to virtual primary and mental-health care.
* 401(k) plan with a dollar-for-dollar company match on the first 5% of eligible compensation.
* 20 days of paid time off, 48 hours of paid sick leave, 11 company holidays, and two paid company-wide rest days.
* Twelve weeks of paid parental leave, company-paid life insurance, and short- and long-term disability coverage.
* Company-provided laptop, a one-time home-office allowance of $1,000, and a monthly internet and mobile-phone allowance of $100.
* Up to $2,000 annually for approved software, project-management, customer-training, or professional-development courses.
* Employee assistance and financial-guidance resources, plus company-paid travel for an annual team meeting.

How the team works

Implementation specialists own their customer projects but can request assistance from technical support, product, data operations, and account management. Complicated issues are assigned to the appropriate team instead of being left with one employee to solve alone.

The team documents configuration decisions and discusses risks early. Specialists are expected to be honest about timelines and product limitations, even when a customer is requesting a faster launch.

Hiring process

* A 30-minute introductory call with a Customer Operations Recruiter.
* A 45-minute interview with the Implementation Team Lead covering your customer-facing experience, software knowledge, and approach to managing multiple projects.
* A 60-minute live implementation scenario using a sample customer account and a small spreadsheet provided during the interview. You will explain how you would organize the launch, identify data issues, and prepare the customer for training. No advance preparation or take-home work is required.
